jobs.title: 1191 - Scheduler
jobs.description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Scheduler , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Responsibilities: Create, assign, and manage all client visits in WellSky, including Start of Care (SOC), Recertification, Resumption of Care (ROC), Follow-Up, and Routine visits. Build and maintain accurate visit schedules for skilled nursing (RN/LPN), therapy (PT, OT, SLP), and aide staff. Enter and update visit authorizations based on payer source, including Medicare, Medicaid, private pay, and managed care plans. Process physician orders tied to visit frequency and duration within WellSky. Monitor the scheduling dashboard daily for unscheduled, missed, or conflicting visits. Coordinate with the clinical team to ensure visit frequency aligns with the Plan of Care (485). Match field clinicians and aides to clients based on availability, geographic location, skill set, and payer requirements. Maintain staff availability calendars, including PTO, call-outs, and schedule changes. Communicate schedule changes to clinicians, aides, and supervisors in a prompt and professional manner. Identify and fill coverage gaps to prevent missed visits and care disruptions. Maintain accurate employee profiles in WellSky, including credentials and authorized service types. Verify and track visit authorizations for all payers prior to scheduling any visit. Alert the billing and intake teams of authorization changes, expirations, or denials in a timely manner. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Senior Product Manager Own the complex product challenges behind the next generation of MedTech software. REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week . Now we're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to take ownership of some of the most important and complex areas of our AI-native platform. The role This is a role for someone who loves product craft, enjoys solving difficult problems and wants substantial ownership over what gets built. You'll work closely with customers, engineers, designers and our founders to turn complex enterprise workflows into AI-native product experiences. You'll own the full product development cycle within your area: Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning. You'll be responsible not just for defining what to build, but for making good decisions, driving execution and ensuring the result actually solves the problem. This is a senior individual contributor role with real product ownership. We don't expect you to manage other PMs, but we do expect you to lead through your judgment, technical understanding and ability to get things done. What you'll do Own complex product areas end to end: Take responsibility for discovery, prioritization, definition, delivery and continuous improvement within your domain. Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, UK or Spain. Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us. jobs.title: New Patient Nurse
jobs.description: If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you. We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives. This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey. It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life. What is the Role? This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants. This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient. If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. jobs.title: Head of People Tech, Data & AI
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose Our members' experience in the clinic is delivered by our people, so people systems and people data are core to how Neko runs, not a back-office report. This role brings People technology, people data and the AI tools our People function builds under one leader. You'll own the architecture of how it all fits together: our HRIS, applicant tracking system, a new ticketing system, identity and access, integrations, automation and analytics, across HQ, our clinics and several countries, and how all of it connects to the rest of Neko. You'll lead a small team of HR technology engineers, people data specialists and product builders who already design and ship AI tools and automations used across the company. You'll work very closely with Corporate Engineering, People Operations and Payroll. Your team builds and runs the systems; you decide what good looks like and stay close enough to the work to tell.
